name: Combat Doctrines
community_notes: [APPROX] Codex army rule. A consumable army-wide stance chosen at the start of your Command phase; each doctrine may be selected once per battle and only one is active for a unit at a time. Devastator grants [ASSAULT] to ranged weapons; Assault and Tactical are captured as opaque eligibility grants. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Adaptive Strategy
community_notes: The chosen Combat Doctrine is active for that unit instead of any doctrine active for the army, even if already selected this battle

name: Storm Of Fire
community_notes: Target must not have been selected to shoot this phase

name: Strike From The Shadows
community_notes: Improvements apply only to attacks against enemy units more than 12" away; if enemy models were destroyed, one destroyed model's unit takes a Battle-shock test. Target must not have been selected to shoot this phase

name: Hail Of Vengeance
community_notes: Usable on a unit that lost one or more models to the attacking unit's attacks; the shooting must target only that enemy unit, and only if it is an eligible target

name: Codex Discipline
community_notes: The Wound re-roll applies against auspex-scanned targets. Target must not have been selected to shoot or fight this phase

name: Mercy Is Weakness
community_notes: Applies to attacks against units below Starting Strength. Target must not have been selected to shoot or fight this phase

name: Power Of The Machine Spirit
community_notes: Vehicle unit reduced to Below Half-strength by the attacking unit's attacks; must target only that enemy unit, if eligible

name: Wind-Swift Evasion
community_notes: Infantry or Mounted unit; cannot select a unit within Engagement Range of enemy units

name: Adept of the Codex
community_notes: At the start of your Command phase, instead of selecting an army-wide Combat Doctrine you can make the Tactical Doctrine active for the bearer's unit only, even if already selected this battle

name: Redoubtable Machine Spirit
community_notes: The wound is regained at the end of your Command phase

name: Gunnery Honours
community_notes: Once per phase: one Hit roll, one Wound roll and one Damage roll

name: Prescience
community_notes: Unit must be unengaged

name: Execute and Redeploy
community_notes: After the bearer's unit shoots, if unengaged, it can make a Normal move of up to 6" but cannot declare a charge this turn; once per Shooting phase

name: Master of War
community_notes: At the end of the opponent's Charge phase, if this unit is unengaged and within 6" of one or more enemy units, it can resolve a charge; when making the charge roll, a result greater than 6 (after modifiers) is changed to 6

name: Stalwart Defenders
community_notes: While every model in this unit is within range of an objective marker, attacks that target this unit have -1 AP

name: Empyric Insight
community_notes: This unit's ranged attacks can ignore modifiers to BS and to Hit rolls and Wound rolls (the DSL's modifier immunity is broader than the printed ranged-only scope)

name: Rapid Reactions
community_notes: Once per turn, in the opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit that targeted this unit has shot: this unit can make a normal move of up to D6+1"

name: Martial Paragon
community_notes: Used when a Character unit is selected to shoot or fight

name: Relentless Assault
community_notes: Used just after the unit Falls Back: choose to shoot or charge — or give in to the Red Thirst (unit becomes Battle-shocked) to do both
